text.jp:
お前が最近噂の救世主か。
１度会ってみたいと思っていたところだった。
text.official_en:
Ah, the much discussed Promised One. I've been
hoping to meet you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
お前のおかげで、この地の命運が
首の皮一枚のところで繋がったようだな。
text.official_en:
I hear it's thanks to you this land hasn't totally slid
into chaos.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
冥界の軍勢は強敵だ。これまで戦ってきた
相手とは一味も二味も違う。
text.official_en:
The forces of the underworld are formidable...unlike
any foe I've faced.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
故に、この神殿もお前たちの
戦いのための力になれればと思っている。
text.official_en: But maybe my temple can aid you in your struggle.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……そうだ、救世主よ。お前を見込んで
俺の頼みを一つ聞いてはくれぬだろうか。
text.official_en: With that in mind, I need a favor.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
俺が昔から愛用している黄金の兜が
何者かによって持ち出されてしまったのだ。
text.official_en: Some blackguard stole my Golden Helm.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この神殿の近くにある洞窟に怪しいものが
逃げ込んだという証言もあるのだが……
text.official_en:
There are reports of a strange character holing up in
a cave nearby... I wonder if that's who did it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
たかだか賊相手にこの軍神が動くわけにもいかぬ。
救世主よ、俺の兜を取り戻してはもらえぬか？
text.official_en:
Unfortunately, the Bringer of War can't take action
against lowly bandits. Would you do it?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
取り戻せたら、最上級の兵種を１つ解放してやろう。
他にも礼を用意する。では、待っているぞ。
text.official_en:
I want my helmet back. Succeed and I'll let you learn
a high-ranking class—among other things.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
今回のことは悪くは思わんでくれ。
噂に聞く救世主がどれほどのものか、
text.official_en: Thanks. I hope you didn't mind the trouble.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
俺としても興味があってな、
一芝居打たせてもらったのだ。
text.official_en:
The truth is, I wanted to see your skills in action,
so I put on a little production.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
詫びと言ってはなんだが……
お前に３つの褒美をやろう。
text.official_en: By way of apology, I'll give you three rewards.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まず１つ目、最上級の兵種「ソードマスター」の
資格試験を受けられるようにしてやろう。
text.official_en:
First, I'll let you take the certification exam for the
<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:08>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それから２つ目、お前にマーズ神殿の神の道の門を
使えるようにしてやる。
text.official_en:
I'll also allow you to use the Gate of the Gods here at
my temple.
text.real_en:
I'll also allow you to use the Gate of the Divine Path here at
my temple.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そして３つ目、俺の持つ武具、
「アーク」を使う機会を与えよう。
text.official_en:
Finally, I'll give you a chance to earn the Arc in my
possession.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アークを使うのには神殿の試練に挑む必要がある。
お前なら、見事乗り越えてみせるだろう。
text.official_en:
You'll have to undertake the temple's trial in order to
use it. But I'm sure you'll have no trouble with that.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
このマーズ神殿本殿の神官に話しかけ
神殿の試練に挑むがいい。
text.official_en: Just go and talk to the priest and give it a try.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……わかったか？　では、そろそろ俺は
ダグシオンへ向かおうと思う。
text.official_en: Understood? Good. Now, I think I'll head to Dagsion.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マーズ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
お前の活躍は、見守らせて貰うぞ。
それではまたな。
text.official_en: I'll be watching your progress. Until next time.
